name: 通話で共有する音の選択グリッド
prompt: Revise LH03-0227 after the user reported that the icons did not match the original. Preserve the current 390x258 Japanese grid and its typography, card placement, white surfaces, neutral borders and selected green outline. Replace each icon with the corresponding original source pixels from source-icons-contact-w02.png, resized into the existing icon position without redrawing or substituting its silhouette: duck, metallic airhorn with blue wave rings, brown cricket, yellow clapping hands with impact marks, gold trumpet, red drum with two sticks. Keep the exact Japanese labels and order. Do not add any tint color. There is no hyperlink text. The displayed v002 candidate was produced by compositing the six original source icon crops onto the reviewed v001 base; a separate image_gen edit was excluded because it changed the overall layout and typography. Remaining card geometry drift from native is about 2-4 pixels.
reviewNotes: 6個のアイコンを原画から切り出した元のピクセルに差し替え、アヒル・青い波紋付き金属ホーン・茶色の虫・手拍子・金色のトランペット・赤いドラムのシルエットを原画に合わせた。カード面は白、非選択枠は中立グレー、選択枠は緑で、色付きの面はない。カード外形はネイティブから約2〜4pxずれが残る。ユーザー指摘を受け、旧v001のアイコン不一致を修正。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: Replace mismatched icon redraws with the six exact source icon crops while retaining the reviewed untinted Japanese grid.
